 Jeff Hardy Manifesting Revival of Bitter Feud With Top WWE Star
 Originally posted on
 SEScoops 
  | 
 By Anutosh Bajpai
  | 
 Last updated Nov 19, 2026 11:39 AM ET
 Add us as a preferred source on Google
 Jeff Hardy is manifesting a feud with CM Punk.
 The former WWE star recently had a new interview with Chris Van Vliet. He talked about things such as his neck injury, being written off TNA programming, still getting excited about high-risk spots, and more.
 During the session, Jeff Hardy was also asked about a potential WWE return, and he claimed that it’s inevitable and he feels like he has a little more time in a WWE ring before it’s all over. 
 The Charismatic Enigma was then asked what more he can manifest after having achieved almost everything in his wrestling career, and the former champion shared interest in working with CM Punk again:
 You are very right. There’s not much. I kind of hate to say this, but I’m such a fan of pro wrestling. I always say Umaga was my favorite feud. But it’s hard not to love the feud between Jeff Hardy and CM Punk. 
 Naturally, when I see him in the WWE universe now, and how good he looks, and how good he’s performing, it’s like, wow, what would that look like? Maybe that’s what I should start manifesting.
 Also Read: Jeff Hardy Reveals The Coolest Thing About His 2008 WWE Title Win 
 Just To See What Would Happen: Jeff Hardy
 Discussing what a feud between the two will look like in 2027, Jeff Hardy said that he would be super interested in seeing how the audience would react to it:
 I’m super interested in what the pop would sound like as far as if there’s any chance of me being a little more popular than him at this point, which would be super interesting just to see what would happen. So, yeah, I’m gonna get the manifesting out there.
 Jeff Hardy defeated Edge to win the World Heavyweight Championship at Extreme Rules, only for CM Punk to cash in his Money In The Bank contract right after. 
 The subsequent feud between the two stars is considered one of the best in WWE history. Their rivalry culminated in Punk beating Hardy in a Loser Leaves WWE steel cage match in August, which ended Jeff’s second run with the company.
